semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Anemo Prime provides HVAC solutions crucial for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Anemo Prime offers specialized HVAC engineering and turnkey solutions designed for cleanrooms, which are essential in semiconductor fabrication facilities. Their focus on energy-efficient air management systems supports the stringent environmental controls required in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.India: Anemo Prime has a manufacturing facility in Bawal and a corporate office in Gurugram, indicating a strong operational presence in India.
